main_text.l: nem soluerit, Legatioque Abarorum ad Roma-
nos, & quæcunque Ardagastus à Romanorum co-
piis passus fit. Porrò etiam quæ propè Tatimerum
facta, fortitudoque Romanorum ducis Alexandri,
& internecio Sclauorum quos adorti erant Roma-
ni. de natis monstris in vrbe regia, altero quadru-
pede, altero bicipite. quomodo Priscus remotus
fit à bello Europæo, deque Theodoro Legato
misso ad Chaganum à Prisco, eiusque prudentia &
dexteritate.
VII.
SEPTIMVS liber memorat de perturbatione
ordinis in exercitu Romano, fortitudinemque
Romanorum contra Sclauos, siue vt antiquitus voca-
bantur, Getas: ac ea, quæ in ignobili quadam
Thraciæ vrbe Petro eiusque subditis acciderunt. &
quomodo Piragastus Sclauorum militum tribu-
nus interemptus, Romanique in aquæ quæ illos fe-
quuta est penuria fortiter se gesserint. & quomod-
o cum Petrus à Sclauis oppugnaretur, Priscus
iterum fit factus Imperator exercitus. mortem
Ioannis Ieiunatoris Constantinopolitani; deque
acceptis à Mauricio pecuniis, eidemque data ac-
cepti Syngrapha. quaque pius princeps reuerentia,
& verè Imperatoria erga mortuum vsus fit, deque
pannosis aliquot per archiepiscopum eiusdem vi-
ri inuentis vestimentis. De Mauris collectis con-
tra Carthaginem ciuitatem, & quomodo Genna-
dij virtute bellum fit extinctum. deq; Cometa qui
per multos dies apparuit. de ciuili bello inter Tur-
cas. & narratione instituta, de republica imperioq;

page.notes: Small-caps or enlarged initial letters ("S" of SEPTIMVS) are read as normal first letters. Line "Romaniquein aquæ quæillos fequuta" appears spaced irregularly in the scan; read as "Romanique in aquæ quæ illos fe-quuta". "pannosij" read as printed; the word may be "pannosis" with a worn letter, marked here as printed. "veltimentis" printed with a long s that looks like l; transcribed as "vestimentis". The right edge carries cropped fragments from the adjacent page, not transcribed.
